methodology: Precomputed synthetic or BMOPF geometry; identity and placement recorded per dataset. No viewport culling or network level of detail; optional open-switch presentation is prepared once on load. Frame intervals from deck.gl onAfterRender; not GPU timer queries. First-draw callback is not a GPU completion fence.

workflowNotes: Static versus magnitude-dependent motion, one completed six-second camera run each. Same source selection retained: French 15-bus profile, SAPN 37-bus profile. Wire picking and profile highlighting on; labels off. SAPN is artificial stress, not a solution. Peak glyphs are observed, not the 512-glyph worst case. CPU/path/markup measurements are separate. Browser frame intervals are not isolated GPU timings.
